reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the research question by proposing a single, testable mechanism (SRO governing phase stability) with a clear intervention (Al variation), measurable outcome (SRO intensity vs. properties), and a falsification rule, while staying within the constraints of single-phase Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni. Hypothesis B introduces nanoscale precipitates and a two-regime mechanism (moderate vs. excessive Al) that is less specific, relies on cited evidence not fully aligned with the alloy system, and makes the mechanism less directly testable as a single governing factor.
